quotes.goal: If A and G be the AM and GM between two positive numbers, then prove that the numbers are A ± √(A² − G²)

note: Call the numbers b + d and b with d ≥ 0 (b + d is the larger). Then A = ((b + d) + b)/2 and G² = (b + d)b are written in directly, so A ± √(A² − G²) is the right side of each part.
